lessonTitle: Acts Chapter 13 — Barnabas and Saul Sent Off / On Cyprus and in Pisidian Antioch

questions.questionText: In which church were there prophets and teachers including Barnabas and Saul?
I am one of the prophets and teachers, called Niger. Who am I?
I had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch. Who am I?
I am Lucius of Cyrene, a teacher in Antioch. Who am I?
While they were worshiping the Lord and fasting, what did the Holy Spirit say?
options: Set apart for me Barnabas and Saul
Go to Rome at once only

questions.questionText: After fasting and praying, what did they do?
options: They placed their hands on them and sent them off

questions.questionText: They went down to Seleucia and sailed to which island?
When they arrived at Salamis, where did they proclaim the word of God?
I was with them as their helper. Who am I?
They traveled through the whole island until they came to where?
I am a Jewish sorcerer and false prophet also known as Elymas. Who am I?
I am the proconsul, an intelligent man who wanted to hear the word of God. Who am I?
Who tried to turn the proconsul from the faith?
From this point I am also called Paul. Who am I?
Paul said Elymas was a child of the devil. What happened to Elymas?
options: Mist and darkness came over him, and he groped about, seeking someone to lead him by the hand

questions.questionText: When the proconsul saw what happened, what did he do?
options: He believed, for he was amazed at the teaching about the Lord

questions.questionText: From Paphos, Paul and his companions sailed to Perga in Pamphylia. Who left them there?
From Perga they went on to where?
On the Sabbath they entered what and sat down?
After the reading from the Law and the Prophets, the leaders said what?
options: Brothers, if you have a word of exhortation for the people, please speak

questions.questionText: Who stood up and motioned with his hand to begin a long speech?
Paul said God chose our ancestors and made the people prosper during their stay in which land?
With whom did God endure for about forty years?
God gave them judges until the time of Samuel the prophet. Then they asked for a king. Who was the first king Paul names?
options: Saul son of Kish, who ruled forty years

questions.questionText: After removing Saul, God made me king, a man after his own heart. Who am I?
From David’s descendants God has brought to Israel the Savior as he promised. Who is the Savior?
Before the coming of Jesus, I preached repentance and baptism to all Israel. Who am I?
Paul said the people of Jerusalem and their rulers did not recognize Jesus. What did they ask Pilate to do?
options: Free Barabbas only is later detail; they condemned him

questions.questionText: What did God do after they took him down from the cross and laid him in a tomb?
options: God raised him from the dead
God made him a judge only

questions.questionText: Paul quoted, “You are my son; today I have become your father.” He said this promise was fulfilled how?
Paul said, “Through Jesus the forgiveness of sins is proclaimed to you.” Through him everyone who believes is set free from every _____.
As they were leaving, the people invited them to speak further on what day?
On the next Sabbath, how many gathered?
When the Jews saw the crowds, they were filled with what?
Paul and Barnabas said they would now turn to whom?
When the Gentiles heard this they were glad. What spread through the whole region?
The Jewish leaders stirred up God-fearing women of high standing and the leading men. What did they do?
options: They expelled them from their region

questions.questionText: Paul and Barnabas shook what off their feet?
Where did they go after Pisidian Antioch?
True or false: The disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.
options: True — but they stayed in Paphos

questions.questionText: I am also called Niger and I served in the Antioch church. Who am I?
John left them to return to which city?
Paul and Barnabas shook the dust off their feet as a warning and went to which city?
The disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit in which region after Paul and Barnabas left?
Who did the Holy Spirit send on the first missionary journey from Antioch?
On Cyprus they proclaimed the word of God in the Jewish synagogues at which city first?
True or false: The proconsul Sergius Paulus believed, for he was amazed at the teaching about the Lord.
Paul said God led Israel out of Egypt and endured their conduct for about how many years in the wilderness?
Fill in the blank: “I have made you a light for the _____.”
